task.title: Compose selected skills into durable completion tool turns
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/668 by preserving explicit skill composition and caller-owned completion intent through bounded provider and tool continuations.
acceptance_criteria: Reject invalid selection and stale or terminal continuation state before forbidden side effects.
Retain exact caller policy, selected skills, transcript, prior tool result, task identity, and completion intent across continuations.
Keep every tool step non-terminal and independently authorized with a fresh invocation identity.
Commit final assistant content, an exact Attempt, and completion in order with unchanged final content as task output.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused completion integration test failed because no composed completion outcome or initial and continuation entrypoints existed.
attempts.patch: Added tests for direct and continued completion, exact authority and result retention, ordered persistence, output equality, and invalid continuation rejection.

attempts.summary: Implemented completion-specific composition around the shared bounded path.
attempts.diagnostic: A typed completion continuation retained terminal intent while shared composed task execution handled provider and tool work; one small finalizer converted final content into Attempt evidence and exact task output.
attempts.patch: Added completion outcomes and operations, reused the established attempt path, documented persistence ordering and non-goals, and updated milestone status.

attempts.summary: Verified the bounded implementation without speculative refactoring.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent pre-commit review found no actionable or blocking issue, and the cooldown-delayed substantive exact-head review generated no actionable comments.
attempts.patch: Retained the symmetric terminal helper, complete integration coverage, and explicit separation between model output and deterministic verification evidence.

outcome.summary: Durable composed completion turns now retain explicit selected-skill authority through bounded tool work and complete with final provider content as both exact Attempt evidence and task output.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30307794206 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/669

lessons: Completion intent belongs in a typed continuation so generic attempt progression cannot discard terminal ownership.
Final provider content may be both Attempt evidence and output, but it is not deterministic verification.
Assistant turn, Attempt, and completion ordering must remain explicit because they are separate durable commits.
Refreshing descriptive tool metadata cannot replace retained policy, skill, transcript, or prior-result context.
A small symmetric terminal adapter is preferable to duplicating the complete provider and tool execution path.
